## `pygeovision.obia.io`

Reading rasters into the (bands, rows, cols) layout used across ``obia``.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `RasterData` | class | A multi-band image plus the georeferencing needed to export results. |
| `load_raster` | function | Read a GeoTIFF into a :class:`RasterData`. |
| `as_raster_data` | function | Accept a path, a :class:`RasterData`, or a (bands, rows, cols) array. |
| `valid_mask` | function | Boolean ``(rows, cols)`` mask of pixels that hold data. |
| `rescale_bands` | function | Stretch every band to 0-255 using percentile clipping. |
| `to_uint8` | function | Rescaled display bands (NaN allowed) -> uint8, with invalid pixels shown as black. |
| `save_raster` | function | Write a 2-D (rows, cols) or 3-D (bands, rows, cols) array as a GeoTIFF. |

## `pygeovision.obia.features`

Object features: the table every OBIA classifier works on.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `clean_name` | function | Make a layer/class name safe to use inside a pandas expression. |
| `glcm_texture` | function | Per-object Haralick GLCM texture. |
| `extract_features` | function | Build the object feature table. |
| `class_context` | function | Neighbourhood features that depend on a (first) classification. |
| `parent_map` | function | Super-object of every fine object (the coarse object covering most of it). |
| `super_object_features` | function | Features describing how a fine object relates to its super-object. |
| `sub_object_fraction` | function | Area fraction of each super-object covered by sub-objects of one class. |

## `pygeovision.obia.classify`

Classifying image objects.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `ClassificationResult` | class | Class per object plus the evidence behind it. |
| `RuleBasedClassifier` | class | Ordered rules, first match wins. |
| `Membership` | class | A function mapping a feature value to a degree of membership in [0, 1]. |
| `Trapezoid` | class | 0 below ``a``, rises to 1 at ``b``, stays 1 until ``c``, falls to 0 at ``d``. |
| `Triangle` | class | Peak of 1 at ``b``, zero at ``a`` and ``c``. |
| `LargerThan` | class | 0 up to ``a``, linear rise to 1 at ``b``, 1 beyond (``a == b`` = hard threshold). |
| `SmallerThan` | class | 1 up to ``a``, linear fall to 0 at ``b``, 0 beyond (``a == b`` = hard threshold). |
| `Gaussian` | class | Bell curve: 1 at ``mean``, falling off with ``sigma``. |
| `FuzzyClassifier` | class | Class descriptions built from membership functions. |
| `ObjectClassifier` | class | Supervised classification of objects from labelled sample objects. |
| `samples_from_geometries` | function | Give each image object the reference class that covers most of it. |
| `samples_from_raster` | function | Turn an existing land-cover map (ESA WorldCover, Dynamic World, an older classification) into *weak* training samples: each object gets the class that most… |
